blocks.body: Heavy wooden door creaking open on rusted hinges, foley, shotgun mic, stairwell, menacing

blocks.label: Why this shape
blocks.body: One event per generation. Layer sequential sounds in an editor rather than asking for a sequence: that is the documented workflow, not a workaround.

flat: Heavy wooden door creaking open on rusted hinges, foley, shotgun mic, stairwell, menacing
notes: Name the source, the material it hits, the space it happens in, and how the tail behaves. That is the whole craft.
warnings: One event per generation, everywhere. Layer in a DAW.

variations.name: Bigger space
variations.text: Same source, change the room to a stairwell or warehouse and let the tail run longer.

variations.name: Closer and drier
variations.text: Close-mic'd, bone-dry, no room at all. This is the version you layer under something else.

variations.name: Just the tail
variations.text: Ask only for the decay, not the impact. Layering the transient separately gives you control over both.
